title: Single-letter and very long names
why: Checks that short first names and long hyphenated or apostrophe-containing last names are accepted and stored intact.

steps.does: POST …/identity/register-user with FirstName 'Li' and a LastName over 100 characters made of repeated segments such as "O'Brien-Smythe-" (hyphens and apostrophes included), Email li.long@example.com, UserName li.long, PassPortNumber CN3322110, Password Str0ng!Pass1, matching ConfirmPassword.

expect: Registration succeeds. The saved FirstName is 'Li' and the saved LastName matches the submitted string exactly, with hyphens and apostrophes preserved.
